finding.evidence: Seven push-event workflow runs for prior head a04b6a08acfd0598a3d6bbbfa5211762e4a7e6ae completed with conclusion=failure and zero jobs returned by the workflow-runs jobs endpoint.
finding.root_cause: The disabled workflow files used a plain-scalar run: echo "Disabled: ..." value. The colon followed by a space inside the unquoted YAML scalar made the workflow YAML invalid.
finding.test_gap: The first regression test checked strings and permissions but did not parse the YAML, so the core Python suite passed while GitHub Actions rejected the workflow definitions.

correction.run_steps: Changed all seven notices to block-scalar run: | steps, keeping the command text as a shell script.
correction.parser: Added PyYAML to the CI test dependencies and parse each workflow with yaml.safe_load.
assertions: workflow_dispatch is the only configured event
no secrets, write permissions or mutation commands

evidence_preservation.action_taken: Preserved the failed runs as evidence; no rerun or external action was initiated.
evidence_preservation.prior_core_ci_result: 345 passed, 8 subtests passed in 7.65s; this did not validate GitHub workflow YAML.

safety: No main change, merge, force-push, secret access, issue mutation, deployment, paper position or real-money action.
